subject.title: fix(talk): diagnose invalid OpenAI realtime auth

question: Should direct `api.openai.com` Realtime reject every key format not currently recognized, or only credentials positively identified as Azure/proxy credentials?
rationale: This is an upgrade-sensitive auth contract: rejecting unknown formats can block valid future OpenAI Platform keys, while allowing them preserves the existing opaque-key behavior and relies on sanitized provider failures.

options.title: Reject only known non-OpenAI formats
options.body: Preserve unknown key formats for direct OpenAI authentication and keep the new safe diagnostic for positively identified Azure/proxy credentials.

options.title: Keep the broad local gate
options.body: Retain the override-backed rejection of unrecognized formats and accept that operators may need to set an environment variable for new direct-key formats.

recommendation.title: Reject only known non-OpenAI formats
recommendation.body: Preserve unknown key formats for direct OpenAI authentication and keep the new safe diagnostic for positively identified Azure/proxy credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor has the clearest available context on the intended credential classification, though a current-main feature owner should make the final decision.
